title.narrative: Interfaith Dialogue and Reconciliation in Palestine

description.narrative: Ung Mosaik - Palestine is a newly established group in Ung Mosaik that especially focuses on religious dialogue between young people from Palestine and Israel, and religious groups consisting of Christians, Muslims and Jews. We have chosen three different organisations that all work with religious dialogue and youth in Palestine and Israel and will visit these on a partner identification trip in October or December 2023. The main objective is to facilitate dialogue, and for the us as Danish partners to see dialogue take place in the difficult circumstances, and to learn from the courage and dedication to democratic dialogue that the partners have. We want to empower young people to bridge the deepest of divides. We will focus on three main topics: -Interreligious dialogue through shared understanding of having faith. -Reconciliation between opposing groups and political fractions. We wish to empower the youth to find their own footing and develop their own opinions on the conflict. -Education on the opposing fractions lived experiences.
